name: Post-Matric Scholarship for SC Students (SSP Karnataka)
provider: Social Welfare Department, Government of Karnataka
benefit: Post-matric scholarship; amount varies by course (see the SSP portal for the exact figure)

name: Post-Matric Scholarship for ST Students (SSP Karnataka)
provider: Scheduled Tribes Welfare Department, Government of Karnataka
benefit: Post-matric scholarship; amount varies by course (see the SSP portal for the exact figure)

name: Post-Matric Scholarship for Backward Classes (BCWD, Karnataka)
provider: Backward Classes Welfare Department, Government of Karnataka
benefit: Up to Rs 20,000 per year (allowance plus tuition). Income limit is Rs 2.5 lakh for Category 1 but only Rs 1 lakh for Categories 2A, 3A and 3B, so check your sub-category. Management-quota and private-seat students are not eligible.
needs_check: income cap per sub-category (Cat-1 Rs 2.5 lakh; 2A/3A/3B Rs 1 lakh)

name: Vidyasiri Food and Accommodation Scheme (BCWD, Karnataka)
provider: Backward Classes Welfare Department, Government of Karnataka
benefit: Monthly food and accommodation assistance (Rs 1,500 per month; confirm on the official page)

name: AICTE Pragati Scholarship for Girl Students
provider: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE) / Ministry of Education
benefit: Rs 50,000 per year (confirm on the AICTE guidelines)

name: Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College and University Students
provider: Department of Higher Education, Ministry of Education, Govt of India
benefit: Rs 12,000 per year for graduation (Rs 20,000 for post-graduation). You must also be in the top 80th percentile of your board stream, which this app cannot check.
deadline: Student application deadline listed on scholarships.gov.in as 31-10-2026; confirm on the portal
needs_check: deadline and whether it applies to new applicants
